acceptance: A pre-commit hook or make check fails if pyproject.toml dependencies are modified without matching updates to docs/development/dependency-audit-raw.md
context: Discovered during PR #2787 followups when pinning bashlex==0.18; make audit-raw-check failed in CI because parse_deps.py had not been run locally.
description: Modifying dependencies in pyproject.toml requires regenerating docs/development/dependency-audit-raw.md via _project/scripts/dependency_audit/parse_deps.py. Today, this is enforced only by make audit-raw-check in CI. Add a pre-commit check or tooling guard that detects when pyproject.toml dependencies change without updating dependency-audit-raw.md, preventing push-time CI failures.
